rationale: The answer is grounded in current implementation and nearly every load-bearing citation checks out. Verified: plugin-sdk is `"private": true` (line 5, answer said 6); ExtensionHost in plugin-host/core.ts with session/module/binding lifecycle (binding states announced/active/degraded/withdrawn at shared/bindings.ts:22), two-layer permission ceiling (core.ts:56-59), and `resolvedGrant = await permissionResolver?.(...) ?? manifest.permissions` (core.ts:250-255) with no resolver wired (`new ExtensionHost({ runtime: 'electron' })` at host/index.ts:236; SetupExtensionHostOptions has only widgetsManager); manifest V1 contract at shared/types.ts:233-253; three kits kit.widget/kit.gamelet/kit.tool registered (kits/index.ts:95-116; ids confirmed in plugin-sdk-tamagotchi); KitUnavailableReason includes incompatible-version but resolveKitApi checks only missing-kit/permission-denied (kit/index.ts:44, core.ts:405-433); node/web runtimes throw on websocket/node-worker/web-worker transports; ExposePolicy declared but never enforced outside a test; ModuleContribution.ui is Record<string, unknown> in plugin-protocol; the Eventa TODO + setMaxListeners workaround and the three-part quit lifecycle (emitAppBeforeQuit + injeca.stop + host before-quit dispose) are real; channel-server (TLS/pairing, injeca lifecycle) and ServerManager ordered start/stop are real; renderer capability types carry a TODO to re-export from the SDK. The desktop platform is Electron; the legacy Tauri `crates/` directory is absent from the checkout and the answer never misidentifies it. The only errors are three minor count/citation imprecisions (setMaxListeners undercount, ~13 vs 14 windows, servers:[] call-site conflation), none decision-relevant, so the accuracy gate passes.
